{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./road_detector.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --time=5:00:00        -> -t 5h
#   --nodes=1             -> -N 1
#   --ntasks-per-node=1   -> -n 1
#   --gpus-per-node=1     -> -g 1
#   --output=srun.out     -> -o output=srun.out
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -g 1 -t 5h -o output=srun.out --wrap "sh $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=GPUQ not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible GPU resources; you are not forcing the GPUQ partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --account=ie-idi not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem=20000 not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-user/--mail-type not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  # NOTE: Slurm environment variables referenced below (SLURM_*) are not set under Flux.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: informational prints will differ.

  WORKDIR=${PWD}
  cd "${WORKDIR}" || exit 1

  echo "we are running from this directory: ${WORKDIR}"
  echo " the name of the job is: ${FLUX_JOB_ID:-job}"
  echo "Th job ID is ${FLUX_JOB_ID:-unknown}"

  module purge
  module load fosscuda/2020b
  module load Anaconda3/2020.07

  flux run -n 1 -g 1 nvidia-smi

  flux run -n 1 -g 1 env PYTHONPATH=/cluster/home/jorgro/road-detector \
    python ./tools/train.py ./configs/road_detector.py --work-dir ./runs

  flux run -n 1 uname -a
fi
"
}

issues: This is a self-submitting pattern: it will only work if `flux batch` can connect to a Flux broker from where the script is executed (inside a Flux instance or via a site-provided submission endpoint).
Portability: requesting a GPU with `-g 1` requires the Flux instance to be configured with GPU/generic resources; otherwise the job may be rejected or remain unschedulable.
No memory limit/reservation is requested in Flux (Slurm `--mem=20000` was omitted), so the job will run with default memory policy, which may differ from the original resource intent.
